methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $30M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
Ideon Technologies is a Series B climate & energy company that has raised $30M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of nine private peers and one public comparable (Lnza), including adjacent-stage companies such as KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $30M total raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $57M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: KoBold Metals ($3.0B, Series C), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B, Series C), and Amogy ($700M, Series C). The median valuation across this set is $1.0B, with a range of $700M to $3.0B.

The two methods produce a wide spread, reflecting material uncertainty in stage-progression calibration versus mature peer comparables. The triangulated range is $48M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median estimate of $528M. The low end represents conservative stage-progression anchoring; the high end reflects peer multiples. Key uncertainties include the relevance of Series C peer valuations to an earlier-stage target, capital intensity trajectory within the climate-tech sector, and whether the peer set adequately represents Ideon's specific technology risk profile.
